gloss: Kokugikan; sumo arena (esp. in Ryōgoku, Tokyo)

definitions.explanation: An arena built for sumo wrestling. By default refers to the {両国|りょうごく}{国技館|こくぎかん} in Tokyo, the main venue for grand sumo tournaments in eastern Japan.

examples.japanese: {国技館|こくぎかん}で{相撲|すもう}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I watched sumo at the Kokugikan.

examples.japanese: {両国|りょうごく}{国技館|こくぎかん}の{席|せき}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I reserved a seat at the Ryōgoku Kokugikan.

examples.japanese: {国技館|こくぎかん}の{近|ちか}くにはちゃんこ{鍋|なべ}{屋|や}がたくさんある。
examples.english: There are lots of chanko-nabe restaurants near the Kokugikan.

notes:
Literally "national-sport hall," from {国技|こくぎ} (national sport) + {館|かん} (hall). The current arena in Ryōgoku opened in 1985 and hosts three of the six annual sumo tournaments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {両国|りょうごく}{国技館|こくぎかん}: Ryōgoku Kokugikan
- {国技館|こくぎかん}の{升席|ますせき}: box seats at the Kokugikan
- {国技館|こくぎかん}で{本場所|ほんばしょ}が{開|ひら}かれる: a grand tournament is held at the Kokugikan
